defect.description: Old archival manifest v1 swapped numeric job IDs. Old wrong_job corruption instead changed json_sha256, so it did not challenge job attribution.

controls: Verifier uses independently pinned job, artifact, original log excerpt Git blob, original manifest blob, original ZIP blobs and original JSON digests; deliberate true wrong-job + swap negatives.
qualification: Log excerpts are verbatim selected lines from API-provided full original logs; selected extracts are NOT full log envelopes. External independent job inspection performed at correction time; Git-only verification establishes integrity of selected extracts and bytes.
